worst_object.reason: Orientation: The back of this object faces into the open space where a chair should be (inconsistent with other images). Floating/Positioning issues in some views make it difficult to understand its base.

comment: This study room scene has strong lighting consistency and realistic textures, creating an inviting atmosphere. However, significant object manipulation artifacts are present: a desk appears rotated backward into the open space and another item is floating.
